section_summary: This section chiefly records Japanese merchant-vessel movements, destinations, cargoes and bills of health in February and early March 1941. Consular telegrams are frequently followed by separate paraphrases sent to the Navy. It also includes a report on unusual Japanese phosphate-shipping activity at Makatea and correspondence about whether vessel reports should be repeated to Military Intelligence in Manila.

people.name: Foster
people.role: sender of São Paulo telegrams relaying Santos reports

people.name: Hornbeck

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru bill of health
subfiles.about: Reports a bill of health for the Nozima Maru, bound for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Nozima Maru received a bill of health for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission routing slip
subfiles.about: Requests Simplex transmission and return of the copy.
subfiles.summary: Simplex transmission instruction.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Nozima Maru bill of health.
subfiles.summary: Nozima Maru was issued a bill of health for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Husimi and Kinugawa bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for vessels bound for Davao and San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: Husimi was bound for Davao and Kinugawa for San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Husimi and Kinugawa paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Osaka bills of health.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase gives Kinugawa’s San Francisco route and Husimi’s Davao route.

subfiles.title: Yokohama vessel departures
subfiles.about: Reports four departures and their American destinations.
subfiles.summary: Kinugasa Maru, Kimikawa, Tosei and tanker Daisan-Tokura departed for routes involving American ports.

subfiles.title: Yokohama departures paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Yokohama sailing report.
subfiles.summary: Lists routes for Tosei, Kimikawa, Daisan-Tokura and Kinugasa Maru.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for four Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Sanuki, Asama Maru, Kunikawa and Fushimi received bills of health for Pacific routes.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays four Kobe bills of health.
subfiles.summary: Names Kunikawa, Sanuki, Fushimi and Asama Maru with their destinations.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru’s arrival from Coquimbo and departure for Pisco.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru arrived and departed on February 19.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Naruto Maru’s Antofagasta call.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru arrived from Coquimbo and left for Pisco.

subfiles.title: Visits of Japanese vessels to French Oceania
subfiles.from: George C. Cobb, American vice consul, Tahiti
subfiles.about: Reports three Japanese phosphate vessels near Makatea and Papeete.
subfiles.summary: Three Japanese cargo ships were present in French Oceania, an unusually large simultaneous call for the Makatea phosphate trade. Cobb gives production figures, notes Japan’s dominant share, and considers whether the concentration relates to the recent raid on Nauru.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel movements
subfiles.about: Reports Syunko Maru and Lisbon Maru arrivals and departures.
subfiles.summary: Both ships sailed toward Karachi; Syunko Maru had arrived from Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: Singapore movements paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Syunko Maru and Lisbon Maru routes.
subfiles.summary: Lists their Singapore arrivals and onward calls.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru leaves Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports Haruna Maru’s departure for Karachi.
subfiles.summary: Haruna Maru sailed from Bombay for Karachi.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru departure paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Haruna Maru’s departure for Karachi.
subfiles.summary: Haruna Maru departed Bombay for Karachi.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports Kansai Maru’s arrival and departure toward Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Kansai Maru arrived from Rio de Janeiro and sailed via Santos, Cristóbal and Balboa.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru Montevideo paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kansai Maru’s Montevideo call.
subfiles.summary: Kansai Maru sailed for Los Angeles after arriving from Rio de Janeiro.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru supplementary paraphrase
subfiles.about: Provides another Navy paraphrase of the Montevideo report.
subfiles.summary: Lists the ship’s calls at Santos, Cristóbal and Balboa en route to Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Manila Maru and Yamazato Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of two Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Manila Maru sailed toward South Africa and Japan; Yamazato Maru sailed toward Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Santos movements paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Manila Maru and Yamazato Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Summarizes both ships’ Santos calls and onward routes.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru at Santos
subfiles.from: Foster, São Paulo, relaying American vice consul at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Nana Maru’s arrival and proposed route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Nana Maru arrived from Buenos Aires and was to sail via Rio de Janeiro, the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Nana Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Nana Maru’s route from Santos to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Gives the ship’s Buenos Aires origin and onward calls.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru and Havana Maru departures
subfiles.about: Reports Nozima Maru’s departure and Havana Maru’s reported sailing.
subfiles.summary: Nozima Maru left for New York; Havana Maru was reportedly sailing for Bombay.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru and Havana Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the two Yokohama vessel routes.
subfiles.summary: Lists Nozima Maru’s American calls and Havana Maru’s route through Southeast Asia.

subfiles.title: Kaizyo Maru and Kanto Maru departures
subfiles.about: Reports a tanker sailing for California and another ship bound for South America.
subfiles.summary: Kaizyo Maru left for San Pedro; Kanto Maru was reportedly sailing via Singapore, Colombo and African ports.

subfiles.title: Kaizyo Maru and Kanto Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Yokohama sailings.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the San Pedro and South America routes.

subfiles.title: Florida Maru and Kano Maru bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for Florida Maru and Kano Maru.
subfiles.summary: Florida Maru was bound for Seattle; Kano Maru’s planned route included Manila, Los Angeles and New York.

subfiles.title: Florida Maru and Kano Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the two vessels’ routes.
subfiles.summary: Gives the Florida Maru and Kano Maru destinations.

subfiles.title: Hoyo Maru naval charter
subfiles.about: Reports Hoyo Maru’s Navy charter, crew and gasoline-loading voyage.
subfiles.summary: The tanker was to sail directly to San Francisco with naval personnel aboard.

subfiles.title: Hoyo Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the tanker’s charter and voyage.
subfiles.summary: Hoyo Maru was to load gasoline at San Francisco while carrying naval officers and sailors.

subfiles.title: Suwa Maru bill of health
subfiles.about: Reports Suwa Maru’s bill of health and onward itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Suwa Maru arrived from Sydney and was to depart Melbourne for Philippine and Japanese ports.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission routing slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential Simplex transmission.
subfiles.summary: Confidential transmission instruction.

subfiles.title: Suwa Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Suwa Maru’s bill of health and route.
subfiles.summary: Lists Australian, Philippine and Japanese calls.

subfiles.title: Hakone Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports Hakone Maru’s arrival from Colombo and departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Hakone Maru sailed via Manila and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission routing slip
subfiles.about: Requests restricted Simplex transmission.
subfiles.summary: Restricted transmission instruction.

subfiles.title: Hakone Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Hakone Maru’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: Hakone Maru arrived from Colombo and departed for Japan.

subfiles.title: Asama Maru and Tuyama Maru departures
subfiles.about: Reports two departures from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Asama Maru sailed for Honolulu and California; Tuyama Maru for Balboa via Los Angeles and Libertad.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission routing slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential Simplex transmission.
subfiles.summary: Confidential transmission instruction.

subfiles.title: Asama Maru and Tuyama Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays both ships’ routes.
subfiles.summary: Asama Maru headed for California; Tuyama Maru headed for Balboa.

subfiles.title: Youeyama Maru and Borneo Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports two vessels arriving and departing for Keelung.
subfiles.summary: Youeyama Maru came from Rangoon; Borneo Maru came from Belawan.

subfiles.title: Youeyama Maru and Borneo Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the vessels’ Singapore calls.
subfiles.summary: Both ships sailed for Keelung after arriving from separate ports.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru at Karachi
subfiles.about: Reports Haruna Maru’s Karachi arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Haruna Maru arrived February 23 and left February 25 for previously reported ports, except Yokkaichi.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru Karachi paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Haruna Maru’s departure and intended calls.
subfiles.summary: Lists Asian ports on its route, while stating their sequence is uncertain.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Rakuyo Maru’s arrival from Arica and sailing for Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Rakuyo Maru sailed via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Rakuyo Maru’s Valparaíso call.
subfiles.summary: The ship departed for Hong Kong via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Goyo Maru’s arrival from Taltal and departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The route included Peruvian ports and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Goyo Maru’s Antofagasta call.
subfiles.summary: Goyo Maru sailed toward Peru, Los Angeles and Kobe.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Naruto Maru’s arrival from Cerro Azul and departure for Huacho.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru left Callao on February 26.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports the ship’s arrival from Cristóbal and planned South American calls.
subfiles.summary: Buenos Aires Maru was to sail for Rio de Janeiro, Santos, Montevideo and Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the La Guaira arrival and departure plan.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Cristóbal and planned four South American calls.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings, February 21–23
subfiles.about: Lists ten reported vessel departures and destinations.
subfiles.summary: The report covers ships bound for Manila, Los Angeles, Seattle, Batavia, Madras, Haiphong, Singapore, Melbourne, Bangkok and Basra.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the multi-vessel Yokohama departure list.
subfiles.summary: Gives departure dates and destinations for the ten vessels.

subfiles.title: Toa, Yamagiri and Kinai Maru bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for three trans-Pacific vessels.
subfiles.summary: Toa Maru was bound for the Canal Zone; Yamagiri and Kinai Maru were bound for New York.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays routes for Kinai, Yamagiri and Toa Maru.
subfiles.summary: The routes involved Asian ports, California and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru leaves Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Sanuki Maru’s departure for western South America.
subfiles.summary: Its route included Honolulu, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Manzanillo and Balboa.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Sanuki Maru’s route.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed toward the west coast of South America.

subfiles.title: Matue at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports Matue’s arrival from Bombay and departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Matue sailed via Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Matue paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Matue’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: Matue arrived from Bombay and sailed for Japan via Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru at Santos
subfiles.from: Foster, São Paulo, relaying American vice consul at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Kansai Maru’s arrival and departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Kansai Maru came from Montevideo and sailed via the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru Santos paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Kansai Maru’s Santos movements.
subfiles.summary: The ship departed for Kobe after arriving from Montevideo.

subfiles.title: Request to repeat ship reports to Manila
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew, American embassy, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Asks whether Japanese vessel reports should be repeated to Military Intelligence in Manila.
subfiles.summary: Grew requests instructions on forwarding the coded consular reports, their addressee and the code to use.

subfiles.title: Corrected copy of Tokyo request
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew, American embassy, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Corrects the request about repeating ship reports to Manila.
subfiles.summary: The corrected copy repeats Grew’s request for forwarding instructions.

subfiles.title: Tokyo request paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Tokyo embassy’s question about sending reports to Manila.
subfiles.summary: Military Intelligence sought copies of coded consular vessel reports.

subfiles.title: Inquiry to War Department liaison officer
subfiles.from: Orme Wilson, State Department liaison officer
subfiles.about: Asks whether the Manila request originated with the War Department.
subfiles.summary: Wilson seeks confirmation or further information about the request.

subfiles.title: Reply to Tokyo on Manila distribution
subfiles.to: American embassy, Tokyo; information to American consul, Manila
subfiles.about: Conveys the War Department’s decision against sending ship reports to Manila Military Intelligence.
subfiles.summary: The War Department would advise the Manila office directly.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.from: Daniels, Mexico City, relaying American consul at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Akagi Maru’s cargo and intended departure.
subfiles.summary: Akagi Maru arrived from Los Angeles, discharged Japanese cargo, loaded drugs and planned to sail for La Unión.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru leaves Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Toa Maru’s departure for eastern South America.
subfiles.summary: Toa Maru’s route included Los Angeles, Balboa and Cristóbal.

subfiles.title: Toa Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Toa Maru’s route from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The ship headed for eastern South America through the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Goyo Maru’s arrival from Cerro Azul and departure for Huacho.
subfiles.summary: Goyo Maru arrived and left Callao on March 1.

subfiles.title: Three Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for three ships bound for New York.
subfiles.summary: Obasan, Nankai and Montreal Maru were to travel via Los Angeles and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Three Kobe bills of health paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the three ships’ planned route.
subfiles.summary: All three were to call at Los Angeles and the Panama Canal before New York.

subfiles.title: Dakar Maru newspaper report
subfiles.about: Relays a newspaper account of Dakar Maru’s departure.
subfiles.summary: The freighter reportedly sailed for Singapore and Rangoon with 1,800 cases of sardines.

subfiles.title: Otowasan Maru sails in ballast
subfiles.about: Reports Otowasan Maru’s direct voyage to Los Angeles for fuel cargo.
subfiles.summary: The ship left Tama in ballast to load oil and gasoline.

subfiles.title: Otowasan Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays Otowasan Maru’s fuel-loading voyage.
subfiles.summary: It sailed directly from Tama to Los Angeles in ballast.

subfiles.title: Four Yokohama sailings
subfiles.about: Reports sailings of Mitta, Yamagiri, Yamahuku and Chuka.
subfiles.summary: Destinations included Manila, New York, New Zealand and Singapore.

subfiles.title: Four Yokohama sailings paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the four reported departures.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the destinations and Yamagiri Maru’s route via Los Angeles and Cristóbal.

subfiles.title: Arimasan Maru and Sumatra Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of two Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Arimasan Maru sailed for Kobe; Sumatra Maru sailed for Keelung.

subfiles.title: Arimasan Maru and Sumatra Maru paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays both ships’ Singapore movements.
subfiles.summary: Sumatra Maru arrived from Karachi; Arimasan Maru arrived from the Philippines.
